notes: Dropped the second mini breadboard (bb2) from the previous graph. The manual's generic parts list says 2 mini breadboards, but the circuit image, which is the authority on connections, needs only one shared bus. Nothing would connect to a second breadboard without inventing wiring the image does not show.

The circuit image does not show a breadboard at all. I placed the shared SCL (column 10t), SDA (column 14t) and 3V3 (rail tp, one strip) nodes on the one mini breadboard. Each pull-up resistor goes between its bus column and the 3V3 rail.
The manual says 10 jumper wires, but the circuit uses only 6 (GND, 2x A5, 2x A4, 3V3), so I listed those 6.
SCL is A5 and SDA is A4, as the text states. The SCL and SDA lines cross in the image without connecting.
Only the reader's 3V3 pin feeds the pull-ups. The writer's 3V3 is not connected.
GND is a single direct jumper from reader GND to writer GND. The Nano Every GND and GND2 pins are joined inside the board, so GND is used.
The USB cables plug into each board's USB port. The computer end is not modelled as a part.
The image draws Nano 33 BLE-style boards, but I kept the Nano Every the text names.
